drafted_from: tool row in tools/train-and-evaluate-a-writing-voice-classifier/tool-rows.json; do-work/train-voice-adapter.py (load_rows, main, the receipt); test/fixtures/training/wording16-train.jsonl and test/test_train_voice_provenance.py for the row shape
start_here: Say to your AI: "Train a writing-voice adapter from ~/voice/train.jsonl into the new folder ~/voice/adapter-1, with the decider frame in ~/decider/finetune." It reads the tool's row, runs the training script on your computer and hands back the receipt.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads a JSONL file of training rows you name and writes an adapter folder with a receipt, both on your computer.
instructions: 1. Write a JSONL file of training rows, one JSON object per line, each with schema "book-voice-adapter-training-row-v1", split "train", state {reference_text, reader_context, target_kind, target_text}, a one-line question, options (2 to 10 named, described choices) and gold (one option name). See the worked example for two rows. Rows with any other split are refused.

2. Have the decider model snapshot and the folder holding its common.py on the computer (python, torch with Apple MPS, b3sum and node are needed). Choose a folder name that does not exist yet for the adapter.
3. Say "Train a writing-voice adapter" with data, out and decider_common_dir. The AI reads the row with tools:list {tool:"tool:train-a-writing-voice-adapter"} and runs its run command.

4. Read the receipt it prints (also saved as train-info.json in the out folder): rows, steps_completed, loss_initial and loss_final, adapter_model_blake3, in_sample_fit_diagnostic. Then score passages with tool:score-writing-with-a-voice-adapter, giving it that folder as adapter.
